newsitem.title: USA: John Kennedy Jr marries girlfriend - TV report.
newsitem.headline: John Kennedy Jr marries girlfriend - TV report.

text.p: Has John F. Kennedy Jr., son of the assassinated U.S. president and once declared "the sexiest man alive," tied the knot?
A Florida television station reported that Kennedy, 35, married girlfriend Carolyn Bessette on remote Cumberland Island off the Georgia coast on Saturday.
There was no immediate confirmation of the reported nuptials from the Kennedy family and a restaurant that reportedly catered the event was tight-lipped on Sunday.

Kennedy -- whose image as a young boy was indelibly etched in the American consciousness when he saluted the flag-draped coffin of his father, President John F. Kennedy, during his funeral -- has often been referred to as the world's most eligible bachelor.
Citing sources on the island, WTLV, an NBC affiliate in Jacksonville, reported that Kennedy and Bessette exchanged vows at a chapel and celebrated the event at a "huge" private party under tents.
Earl Moore, chief of staff for Representative Joe Kennedy, a Massachusetts Democrat, said he knew nothing about a wedding and the congressman was in his home state through the weekend.

The Florida Times-Union reported that security was unusually high on the island, a resort playground of pristine beach and wilderness accessible by ferry from St. Mary's, Georgia, just north of the state's border with Florida.
The newspaper said security guards turned away curiousity-seekers and the north end of the island was closed to the public late on Saturday afternoon.
WTLV reported that members of the Kennedy family were staying at the Greyfield Inn, a secluded bed and breakfast, but said managers there would not confirm anything.

But the station said that a manager of a Fernandina Beach, Florida restaurant that catered the event said her staff told her that Kennedy and Bessette were married. Contacted on Sunday, another manager at the restaurant said "I cannot confirm or deny" the report.

The Times-Union, citing an unnamed source, reported that the Greyfield Inn had no guests all week but was preparing for a big weekend event. It also reported that friends of Greyfield employees said the staff had undergone Secret Service checks because they were told Hillary Clinton would attend the event.
WTLV also reported that Sen. Edward Kennedy of Massachusetts flew to nearby Fernandina Beach early Saturday.
Bessette and Kennedy, longtime companions, had a screaming confrontation in New York's Central Park early this year that was videotaped and photographed.
Kennedy, publisher of the political magazine George and Bessette, a publicist for designer Calvin Klein, had lived together for a year at the time.
Before that, he had a widely publicised, on-again, off-again relationship for several years with actress Darryl Hannah.
During the 1980s after graduating from New York University law school he worked briefly in the Manhattan District Attorney's office after passing the New York Bar after several attempts.
He started the high-profile magazine after leaving his job in the prosecutor's office.
